title: 第5章 牧唐到来第6章 斩杀牧唐
content_zh:
铁林三人身上，基本没什么好东西，所以牧帆也没有去管尸体。
山脉外围区域中的灵兽实力偏弱，并且稀少，但还是有的，用不了多久就会将三具尸体都清理了。
“也不知道我的行踪有没有暴露……”
牧帆陷入沉思。
只希望他在这蛮牛山脉的事，不要被传出去，再多给他一些时间！
就可以回去报仇了！
铁林三人直奔他而来，牧帆已经猜测到，牧族估计是给出悬赏什么的了。
因为这是牧族惯用的手段，发动更多的人为他们办事，效率也往往很高。
牧帆回到山洞中，继续闭关。
修为的提升，除了底蕴，在体内积攒灵气之外，更重要的是对境界的感悟。
所以在没有恢复到玄武境四重之前，牧帆的提升都会非常的夸张。
这不，才一晚上的时间，他就连续突破，提升到了黄武境四重。
牧帆知道，想要报仇，修为最起码要先恢复到以前的高度，否则就是白白去送死。
……
一转眼，三天过去。
在这期间，偶尔有武者来蛮牛山脉猎杀灵兽。
牧帆都一直隐藏着，并没有被发现。
见到牧帆躲入蛮牛山脉的，只有铁林三人，如今这三人都死了，不会有人知道。
牧帆的修为，也是恢复到了黄武境七重！
这三天，一天提升一重。

这也没办法，境界一高，积攒灵气底蕴就更费劲儿。
当然了，对于恢复起来能有这种速度，牧帆还是相当满意的。
这比他想象中快上了不知多少倍。
躲在这个地方修炼，没有人打扰，非常合适，牧帆自然不会出去，因此多找了点吃的就回山洞中继续修炼。
……
蛮牛镇，少了三个恶霸，镇子的人都是高兴得很。
他们并不知道铁林三人去了哪里，反正不来祸害人就行。
……
清风城，牧府。
牧建阳汇报道：“族长，三位长老，到处都搜过了，并未发现牧帆的行踪。”
牧海雄皱着眉头，“难不成，牧帆那小子还真远离清风城了？”
牧唐恨不得扒了牧帆的皮，沉声道：“我觉得他肯定是躲起来了！”
牧海雄思考着对策。
大长老白发苍苍，眼神却是狠辣，“这样搜下去不是办法，范围太大了。”
此时，二长老开口：“牧帆如果躲了起来，那么他能躲在哪里？”
牧海雄目光一凝，道：“清风城他不可能待得了，附近的村镇我们都有人，也很难藏身。”
二长老微微点头，“如果我是牧帆，会选择离开，远离清风城！
若是不远离清风城，那么就只能躲起来，城镇都被盯着，最好的方法就是躲入人少，又适合藏身的地方，诸位觉得哪里藏身合适？”
“肯定是山林中合适藏身！”
三长老道。

牧建阳插话说道：“山脉那些地方，我们确实没有去搜过。”
二长老继续道：“清风城附近，大一点的山脉，也就迷龙山脉、蛮牛山脉、虎牙山脉，牧帆若是没有离开，多半是藏在其中一处！”
牧海雄也觉得有理，“二长老此言甚是，传本族长命令，牧建阳、牧唐、牧空，你们三人各自带些人去这三座山脉外围搜寻牧帆，找到了牧帆，可以直接杀，要是没有找到牧帆，必须第一时间派人回来报信，天黑之前没有报信，本族长就当你们找到了牧帆，立即派出人手来增援。”
牧建阳点头，“是，族长！”
content_en:
There was basically nothing good about the three Tielin people, so Mu Fan didn't bother with the corpses.
The spirit beasts in the outer areas of the mountain range are weak and rare, but there are still some. It won't take long to clean up all three corpses.
"I don't know if my whereabouts have been exposed..."
Mufan fell into deep thought.
I just hope that the news about him in the Manniu Mountains will not be spread out, and give him more time!
You can go back and take revenge!
Tielin and the other three came straight towards him, and Mu Fan had already guessed that the Mu clan was probably offering a reward or something.
Because this is a method commonly used by herdsmen, it can mobilize more people to do things for them, and the efficiency is often very high.
Mu Fan returned to the cave and continued to retreat.
In addition to the accumulation of spiritual energy in the body, the improvement of cultivation is more important than the understanding of the realm.
Therefore, before returning to the fourth level of Xuanwu Realm, Mu Fan's improvement will be very exaggerated.
No, in just one night, he made continuous breakthroughs and was promoted to the fourth level of Huangwu Realm.
Mu Fan knew that if he wanted to take revenge, he had to at least return his cultivation to its previous height, otherwise he would die in vain.
…
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.
During this period, warriors occasionally came to the Manniu Mountains to hunt spiritual beasts.
Mu Fan has been hiding and has not been discovered.
The only people who saw Mu Fan hiding in the Manniu Mountains were Tielin and three others. Now that these three people are dead, no one will know.
Mu Fan's cultivation level has also returned to the seventh level of Huangwu Realm!
In these three days, one level will be improved every day.
There's nothing you can do about it. As your level increases, it becomes more difficult to accumulate spiritual energy.
Of course, Mu Fan was quite satisfied with the speed of recovery.
This was countless times faster than he imagined.
It was very suitable to hide in this place to practice without being disturbed. Mu Fan naturally wouldn't go out, so he found some more food and went back to the cave to continue practicing.
…
In Manniu Town, there are three less bullies, and the people in the town are very happy.
They didn't know where the three Tielin people had gone, as long as they didn't come to cause harm to anyone.
…
Qingfeng City, Mufu.
Mu Jianyanghui reported: "The clan leader and three elders have searched everywhere and found no whereabouts of Mu Fan."
Mu Haixiong frowned, "Is it possible that that kid Mu Fan is really far away from Qingfeng City?"
Mu Tang wanted to peel off Mu Fan's skin and said in a deep voice, "I think he must be hiding!"
Mu Haixiong thought about countermeasures.
The great elder had gray hair, but his eyes were fierce, "It's not an option to search like this, the scope is too large."
At this time, the second elder said: "If Mu Fan is hiding, then where can he hide?"
Mu Haixiong's eyes narrowed and he said: "It is impossible for him to stay in Qingfeng City. We have people in the nearby villages and towns, and it is difficult to hide."
The second elder nodded slightly, "If I were Mu Fan, I would choose to leave and stay away from Qingfeng City!
If you don't stay away from Qingfeng City, you can only hide. The town is being watched. The best way is to hide in a place with few people and suitable for hiding. Where do you think it is suitable to hide? "
"It must be a suitable place to hide in the mountains and forests!"
The third elder said.
Mu Jianyang interjected: "We have indeed not searched those areas in the mountain range."
The second elder continued: "Near Qingfeng City, there are larger mountain ranges, namely the Milong Mountains, the Manniu Mountains, and the Huya Mountains. If Mu Fan has not left, he is probably hiding in one of them!"
Mu Haixiong also felt that it made sense, "What the second elder said is true. Here is the order from my clan leader, Mu Jianyang, Mu Tang, and Mu Kong. Each of you three will take some people to search for Mu Fan outside the three mountains. If you find Mu Fan, you can kill him directly. If Mu Fan is not found, you must send someone back to report it as soon as possible. If there is no report before dark, my clan leader will treat it as if you have found Mu Fan and immediately send reinforcements."
Mu Jianyang nodded, "Yes, clan leader!"
